reasons.plausibility: The idea of adding a self-lubricating phase to form a stable tribofilm is well-grounded in known tribology principles and is logically consistent with improving wide-temperature friction performance.
reasons.testability: A clear comparative tribological experiment is proposed with specific metrics and conditions that can directly confirm or refute the claim.
reasons.usefulness: It provides a concrete intervention with a well-defined mechanism to address a real-world challenge in high-temperature tribology of HEAs.
